answer: Proof of unique payroll contribution record with tax authority attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because contributions the tax authority recorded across years of employment, the zephyr of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the thread is that asymmetry in plain numbers. The fable is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
